\newpage

\markright{\textit{Figure S1.1}}

\noindent{\fontsize{12}{14.4}\selectfont\textbf{FIGURE S1.1}}

\noindent{\fontsize{10}{12}\selectfont\textbf{Spectral validation of confirmed chemical identifications with variant-associated differences in thyroid tumor samples.} Sample spectra for chemicals with statistically significant differences in detection or abundance across thyroid cancer variants that passed manual spectral quality review, displayed either as mirrored plots with reference standard (sample intensity in positive y-axis, standard intensity in negative y-axis) or as non-mirrored plots without standard when reference co-elution was inadequate. Mirrored plots with co-elution of multiple fragments in both standard and sample are considered ``Level 1'' identifications (S1.1, pp. 2-23), while non-mirrored plots where multiple fragments co-elute in the sample but the standard does not show proper co-elution are considered ``Level 2'' identifications (S1.2, pp. 24-26). Asterisks (*) indicate the fragment used for statistical comparison and displayed in Figure 3 and/or Table 3. For select compounds, additional plots display isolated fragments for enhanced visualization clarity.}
